data <- read.csv("../data/Cleaned_Pilot/Cleaned_Pilot.08.csv", header=TRUE, comment.char="#", stringsAsFactors=TRUE)%>%
    dplyr::select(user_id, condition, risk, gain, experimental_treatment_selected)
#standarize the variables
data <- group_by(data, user_id) %>% 
   mutate(risk_z= scale(risk)) %>% 
   mutate(gain_z= scale(gain))
#this runs a logisic model for the data grouped by user id using the scaled IV as created above
m.lr = by(data, data$user_id, function(x) glm(experimental_treatment_selected ~ risk_z + gain_z, data = x, family = binomial(link = "logit"),control=glm.control(maxit=50)))
## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred

## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred

## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred

## Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred
#extract the betas
beta= list()
n <- nrow(data)/75
user_id <- names(m.lr)
for (i in 1:n){
dat = m.lr[[i]]$coefficients
  beta[[i]] = dat
}
x = do.call(rbind, beta)
colnames(x) <-  c('Intercept', 'risk_beta', 'gain_beta')
x <-  cbind.data.frame(x, user_id)
data.h <- merge(data, x, "user_id") %>% 
  distinct(user_id, condition,  risk_beta, gain_beta) %>% 
#remove outliers;
filter(user_id != "FIvIqXVg") %>%   
filter(user_id != "tTZWd9tg") %>% 
filter(user_id != "ZJ8tICU0") %>% 
filter(user_id != "4lsMLrPn") %>% 
filter(user_id != "0XnbWTTY") %>% 
filter(user_id != "fhRzSGIL") %>% 
filter(user_id != "dxBvcmlX") %>% 
filter(user_id != "1mvqe1Y3") %>% 
filter(user_id != "NEFYx2OX") %>% 
filter(user_id != "WFQRR38I") 

# exponetiate
data.h[, 3:4] <- apply(data.h[,3:4], 2, function(X) exp(X))
#log transform
data.h[, 3:4] <- apply(data.h[,3:4], 2, function(X) log(X))
#take absolute weights
data.h[, 3:4] <- apply(data.h[,3:4], 2, function(X) abs(X))

data.h.long <- data.h %>% 
  melt(id = c("user_id","condition"), variable.name = "type", value.name = "beta")
ggplot(data.h.long, aes(x=type, y=beta, fill=type)) + geom_boxplot()+
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, geom = "errorbar", color = "red") + 
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "red")

Here are the one way t-test for risk and gain

#one way t-test for risk to that of zero
t1 <- t.test(data.h$risk_beta, mu=0, var.equal=TRUE)
#one way t-test for gain to that of zero
t2 <- t.test(data.h$gain_beta, mu=0, var.equal=TRUE)
#two way t-test for risk and gain
t3 <- t.test(beta ~ type, data.h.long, paired=TRUE)
#create table
tab <- map_df(list(t1, t2, t3), tidy)
kable(tab[c("method","estimate", "statistic", "conf.low", "conf.high", "p.value")])

##H2
one way anova for ef fect of condi tion on risk and gain 
aovrisk <- aov(risk_beta ~ condition, data=data.h)
aovgain <- aov(gain_beta ~ condition, data=data.h)
# Tukey test to study each of the conditions:
TUKEYrisk <- TukeyHSD(aovrisk)
TUKEYgain <- TukeyHSD(aovgain)
#test representation :
plot(TUKEYrisk , las=1 , col="orange")

kable(TUKEYrisk$condition)
